correctness.rationale: The source kernel is normalized and equals rejection sampling from a uniform candidate with acceptance 1-d_i/D. Conditional first-rejection probability is exactly 1/n regardless of prior state, yielding independent Bernoulli trials. Exponential concentration plus dyadic Borel--Cantelli establishes R_N/log N -> m a.s. Histogram TV is bounded by 2R_N/N. Uniform recursive vertex indegrees are sums of independent Bernoulli variables: Poisson limit at birth-rank fraction u, integration over u gives the shifted geometric law. McDiarmid concentration and discrete tightness upgrade expected marginals to almost-sure total-variation convergence. Standalone rational and sampled checks corroborate every finite kernel identity; they are not used as an infinite proof.
